text: To the organist he cried, Mr. Say, when you play Never mind the wedding tune Rattle out those keys with a foxtrot Please do it on the hearty moon Everybody's crazy on the foxtrot The funny foxtrot, the giddy foxtrot Everybody's busy when the band plays And the sneaky sly they do First of all you do it with your right foot
